scope.nonApplicableRemainder: Every strict accepted COL26.8 species owned by the other-animals remainder route below N but not descending from 5Y; this complete remainder is explicitly excluded from the Rotifera sidecar.
scope.boundary: This mixed package contains many animal phyla and broader Animalia navigation content. This sidecar covers only the strict accepted COL26.8 species descending from the exact Rotifera root 5Y; all remaining package-owned species are explicitly out of scope.

normalization: Remove the exact trailing COL authorship field from COL scientificName when that suffix is present; no authorship parser is used.
Normalize Unicode to NFC, replace underscores with spaces, collapse Unicode whitespace and trim.
For species-rank comparison, remove one parenthesized subgenus token in the exact Genus (Subgenus) species representation; genus and specific epithet must remain unchanged.
Preserve case, diacritics, punctuation and all remaining name tokens.

statuses.accepted: The normalized COL name resolves to exactly one valid ITIS Rotifera species and directly equals that current ITIS name.
statuses.synonym-current-name-redirect: The normalized COL name equals official ITIS invalid species-name evidence that resolves to exactly one valid ITIS Rotifera species.
statuses.ambiguous: The normalized exact evidence resolves to more than one valid ITIS Rotifera species TSN.
statuses.unmatched: No normalized exact valid-name or official ITIS species-synonym evidence resolves to a valid ITIS Rotifera species.

exactMatching.prohibited: No fuzzy, edit-distance, phonetic, case-folded, diacritic-stripped, token-reordered or taxon-substituted matching is used.

evidenceBoundary.en: This CC0 ITIS sidecar is a frozen exact nomenclatural crosswalk, not a global rotifer checklist, final classification authority, phylogeny, species-concept equivalence assertion, biological dossier or scientific-review record.
evidenceBoundary.zh: 此 CC0 ITIS 侧车是冻结的严格命名交叉映射；它不是全球轮形动物名录、最终分类权威、系统发育树、物种概念等同性声明、生物档案或科学审查记录。

colUsageIdLocator.stableAddressing: Binary-search non-overlapping inclusive colUsageId ranges; one detail query loads exactly one immutable JSONL gzip shard.

upstreamOnly.stableAddressing: No COL usage ID is assigned. The complete ITIS-only current-species partition is in its own immutable JSONL gzip shard.
